text:
The canvas holds:
pay-someone-new — Entry screen for the MVP's core solution (seq 7: payee-creation API callable from the app channel) scoped to a single UK sort-code/account-number payee (seq 12's in-bounds case). Includes a hidden modal-dialog for the close-match decision customers must resolve unaided (seq 6, seq 23) before continuing.
confirm-and-send — Follows pay-someone-new once Confirmation of Payee has run: shows the match result and the first-payment limit (seq 23's stated refusal — no skipping the check, a cap on day one), and carries the scam-intervention decision as a hidden modal-dialog (seq 8, seq 17: the screen must do the job the agent's ear used to do) whose shown text and the customer's response are exactly what the audit trail and security boundary require (seq 14, seq 30).

Propose the next screen.

input.why: Closes the journey confirm-and-send commits to: the completion point seq 16's eval counts toward the 85% first-attempt-without-a-call pass rate, and the record shown here (payee, amount, reference, timestamp) is the customer-facing slice of the audit trail seq 18/19 require to be kept in order.

text: Screen **payment-sent** has been proposed: the completion screen that closes the pay-someone-new → confirm-and-send flow. It shows the payee, amount, reference and timestamp — the customer-facing record that mirrors what seq 18/19's audit trail retains — and is the point at which seq 16's "85% finish without a call" eval would count a success. "Done" is the screen's one committing action, returning the customer to wherever they started.
